lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: I’m Pip! Six keys lead to one royal surprise!

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Look! The sun is our first clue!

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Next, let’s restore the courtyard fountain!

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Look at the water — it's shaped like a horse!

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: A horse means the stables. That's where we go next!
